prerequisites: Knowledge of the Fundamental Principle of Statics
These prerequisites are covered in L2 GMP at UGA.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the basics of deformable solids mechanics for small deformations obtained during elastic and isotropic behavior, with the goal of performing solid dimensioning calculations.

syllabus_topics: Cauchy stress: stress vector, stress tensor, equilibrium equations.
Linearized strain tensor: strain-displacement relationship, compatibility equations.
Isotropic linear elasticity: Hooke's law, plane stress, plane strain and axisymmetric problems.
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
